import pandas as pd
t = tables['trips']
t2 = t[(t.season==2)]
t2 = t2.assign(ypa = t2.yt/t2.anglers.replace(0,pd.NA))
t2['bucket'] = (t2.doy//15)*15
g = t2.groupby(['bucket','cls']).apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'yt':d.yt.sum(),'ang':d.anglers.sum(),'n':len(d)})).reset_index()
g['ypa'] = g.yt/g.ang
piv = g.pivot(index='bucket', columns='cls', values='ypa').round(3)

# boat-level 3Q last 21 days

import pandas as pd
t = tables['trips']
t2 = t[t.fish_date_season==2].copy()
t2['ypa'] = t2.yt/t2.anglers.replace(0,pd.NA)
t2['bucket'] = (t2.fish_date_doy//15)*15
g = t2.groupby(['bucket','cls']).apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'yt':d.yt.sum(),'ang':d.anglers.sum()})).reset_index()
g['ypa'] = (g.yt/g.ang).round(3)
piv = g.pivot(index='bucket', columns='cls', values='ypa')

recent = t2[(t2.cls=='three_quarter') & (t2.fish_date_doy>=131)]
boat = recent.groupby('boat').apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'yt':d.yt.sum(),'ang':d.anglers.sum(),'n':len(d)})).reset_index()
boat['ypa'] = (boat.yt/boat.ang).round(3)
boat = boat.sort_values('ypa', ascending=False)

clim = tables['climate']
clim2 = clim[clim.avail_season==2].sort_values('avail_doy').groupby('index_id').tail(1)

pier = tables['pier']
pier2 = pier[pier.ts_season==2].sort_values('ts_doy')
recent_temp = pier2.tail(200).wtmp_c.mean()

out = []
out.append("=== ypa by 15-day bucket x class (season2, fish_date) ===")
out.append(piv.to_string())
out.append("\n=== three_quarter boats, fish_date_doy>=131 ===")
out.append(boat.to_string())
out.append("\n=== latest climate indices ===")
out.append(clim2[['index_id','value','avail_doy']].to_string())
out.append(f"\nrecent pier temp mean (last 200 readings, C): {recent_temp:.2f} = {recent_temp*9/5+32:.1f}F")
result = "\n".join(out)
